svg.title: First Contact
svg.desc: First Contact measured battlefield. North is up. Arrows measure terrain edges and objective centers from table edges. Terrain labels give width by depth in inches. One relay. Score at the end of rounds 2, 3, and 4.

g.text: Arrows: distance to edge or point. All measurements in inches.
One relay. Score at the end of rounds 2, 3, and 4.
Terrain borders are exact. Patterns do not add obstacles.
